description: This file implements an S3-based cache system with methods for setting, getting, and asynchronously handling cache entries, including batch operations. It defines the S3Cache class inheriting from BaseCache, utilizing boto3 for S3 interactions and supporting TTL expiration.

classes.name: S3Cache
classes.description: A cache implementation that stores data in Amazon S3, supporting synchronous and asynchronous operations with TTL expiration.

methods.name: set_cache
methods.description: Stores a value in S3 with optional TTL, serializing the data to JSON.

methods.name: get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value from S3, handling expiration and deserialization.

methods.name: async_set_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously stores a cache entry using run_in_executor.

methods.name: async_get_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a cache entry using run_in_executor.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline
methods.description: Performs batch asynchronous cache set operations.
